metadata.name: Aurelia Portfolio Vendor Assurance
metadata.description: A deterministic 50-vendor enterprise environment for parallel evidence review, exception discovery, remediation, and governed risk acceptance.

scenario.title: Quarterly production-vendor assurance campaign
scenario.instruction: Review every in-scope production vendor, validate security, privacy, architecture, and legal evidence, create accountable remediation for every real exception, and route material risks to designated humans.

tools.name: vendor.list
tools.description: List in-scope vendors, optionally filtered by criticality or review status.

tools.name: vendor.read
tools.description: Read one vendor with its requirements, evidence, findings, exceptions, and remediation work.

tools.name: evidence.search
tools.description: Search source evidence by vendor, requirement, or assurance domain.

tools.name: evidence.record_finding
tools.description: Record a source-grounded valid, missing, stale, or contradictory evidence finding.

tools.name: exception.create
tools.description: Create a governed vendor exception from a recorded non-valid evidence finding.

tools.name: work.create_task
tools.description: Create owned remediation work for a vendor exception.

tools.name: drive.write_document
tools.description: Create the portfolio assurance report or another shared artifact.

tools.name: approval.request
tools.description: Request human acceptance of a material vendor exception.

tools.name: approval.resolve
tools.description: Resolve a pending gate as a designated human.
